summary: Iteration-12 — Backend + frontend tested for (a) BatchIn.partner_ids list with existence validation on create/update, (b) PATCH /batch-payments/{pid}/receive splitting amount equally into N approved income txns (one per partner) with source='milestone' & milestone='1st|2nd|3rd', rounding tail goes to last split so sum == total, (c) empty partner_ids → 1 unassigned txn with partner_id=None, (d) new GET /api/dashboard/milestone-income returning {total, by_milestone, by_partner, by_project, count} with start/end/project_id/center_id filters + user scope + 'Unassigned' grouping, (e) Programs.jsx partner multi-select + 'Partners on this batch' card with per-partner Configured/Received split, (f) Dashboard.jsx Milestone Income section (4 KPIs + 2 breakdown tables) shown only when count>0. Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter12_milestone_partners.py with 11 tests; ALL PASS. Full regression: 152/152 pass in ~34s (141 prior + 11 new — no regression). Live UI on /programs verified partner-split-section with 2 partner-split-* cards showing ₹50,000 Configured + ₹50,000 Received each on TEST_split_batch_af476e (total ₹1,00,000). New Batch dialog shows partner-multiselect with 36 partner-check checkboxes. Dashboard milestone-income-section shows expected aggregates (Unassigned ₹85,000 with 22.1%, partners ₹50,000 each at 13.0%, by_project lists TEST_iter12_proj_af476e ₹1,25,100 at 32.5%).

issues: Pre-existing Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) console warnings — same as iter-10/11, not blocking.
Partner-wise Split shows leftover TEST_* partner names from prior iterations (≥8 rows) — noise but expected on a shared test env. Production env will look clean.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py receive_batch_payment: writes N transactions THEN updates the payment row. If the final update_one fails after some txns inserted, ghost income txns remain (same concern as iter-11 — minor). A Mongo transaction (replicaset session) wrapping txn-inserts + payment-update would harden it; low priority since both ops are tiny single-doc ops.

server.py /batches PUT does not re-validate partner_ids on update — only POST validates them. A typo'd / deleted partner_id can be smuggled in via PUT and will silently corrupt later milestone splits. Recommend extracting the validation block in create_batch and reusing it inside update_batch.

server.py receive_batch_payment uses round(rec['amount'] / N, 2) for share and last_share = round(amount - share*(N-1), 2). For amount=100 / N=3 this yields 33.33+33.33+33.34=100 ✅ (verified). For amount=1/N=3 it would yield 0.33+0.33+0.34=1.00 ✅. But for amount=0.01 / N=3 → share=0.00 (skipped due to amt<=0 guard) and last_share=0.01 → only 1 txn created instead of 3. Edge case but worth a `min amount` check upstream (e.g. BatchPaymentIn.amount >= 1).

Dashboard.jsx milestone-income endpoint is fetched on every filter change via api.get('/dashboard/milestone-income', { params: query }) but never re-fires when only the local milestone-section's filters change (it shares the dashboard-level company/partner/center/project filters which is fine). No issue, just confirming behaviour.

Programs.jsx 'Partners on this batch' card displays split = totalConfigured / partner_ids.length on the client — this is correct math today but it diverges from the actual stored partner_id breakdown on transactions if a user manually edits an existing milestone txn's amount or partner_id outside of /receive. UI shows the *theoretical* equal share, not the *actual* aggregated share. Consider labelling as 'Equal share' or pulling real per-partner sums from /dashboard/milestone-income?project_id=&center_id= for accuracy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 6 partner-split / multi-select / dashboard UI checks passed)

seed_data_creation: Per test run: 1 TEST project + 1 TEST center + 3 TEST partners (pA/pB/pC) + 3 TEST batches (split, no-partner, rounding) + 3 batch payments (1st ₹1L split / 2nd ₹100 rounding tail / 3rd ₹25k unassigned). All tagged with random TAG suffix so re-runs do not collide.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` for full regression (152 tests, ~34s on this env). NEW data-testids on /programs: partner-multiselect (container in New/Edit Batch dialog), partner-check-{partnerId} (each checkbox), partner-split-section (card shown when activeBatch.partner_ids.length>0), partner-split-{partnerId} (each per-partner card). NEW data-testids on /dashboard: milestone-income-section (only rendered when count>0), milestone-by-partner (the partner table), milestone-by-project (the project table). filter-batch on /programs is a shadcn Select (NOT a native <select>) — to drive it from Playwright, click([data-testid=filter-batch]) then click the [role=option] whose text matches. Backend endpoint: GET /api/dashboard/milestone-income returns {total, by_milestone:{1st,2nd,3rd}, by_partner:[{partner_id,partner_name,amount}], by_project:[{project_id,project_name,amount}], count}. Unassigned partner_id is grouped with partner_id=None, partner_name='Unassigned'. BatchIn.partner_ids is validated on POST but NOT on PUT — flagged in code review.
